module: Very simple steering autopilot: a PID corrects the steering so that the vehicle drives toward a target point (or straight ahead, 20 m in front of its initial position). It sends the command via input.event("steering", value, 1) every frame. Controls neither throttle nor brake.
notes: Modes: "offroad" uses a PID (0.8, 0.5, 0); any other mode uses (0.4, 0, 0), output clamped to [-1, 1]. The mode parameter is concatenated in a print: passing nil causes an error.
The target is recomputed every frame: targetPos = baseTargetPos + ((pos - 20) * offset) with offset = (0,1,0); only the Y axis is therefore adjusted (behavior as read in the code).
No check that steeringPID exists: updateGFX only acts if baseTargetPos is defined, which only happens after setTargetDirection.
The angle error is shaped (square root with sign preserved) before the PID.

setTargetDirection.desc: Enables driving toward a target. Without a target, aims at the point 20 m in front of the vehicle in the current direction (projected horizontally). Creates the steering PID according to the mode.

target.desc: Target position; nil = 20 m straight ahead.

mode.desc: "offroad" for a more aggressive PID, any other value for the standard PID. Must not be nil.

stop.desc: Stops the assist: sends input.event('steering', 0, 0) and clears the target.

updateGFX.desc: Called every graphics frame via extensions.hook('updateGFX'). If a target is defined, computes the angle error and sends the PID steering via input.event('steering', ...).

dt.desc: Time step in seconds, passed to the PID.

onInit.desc: Hook called on vehicle initialization (extensions.hook('onInit')): clears the target.

onReset.desc: Hook called on vehicle reset; same function as onInit: clears the target.
